name: Jose M. Ferrer
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Miami, Florida
about: Jose M. Ferrer is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation, Civil Litigation: Plaintiff, International and Civil Litigation: Defense.

Jose Ferrer, who practices law in Miami, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Tulane University Law School. He graduated in 1999. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
